newsitem.title: USA: Emcor Group stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: Emcor Group stake raised by group.

text.p: A group including the Los Angeles-based Oaktree Capital Management said Tuesday it has increased its stake in Emcor Group Inc's oustanding common shares to 1,073,645 shares or 11.3 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it most recently acquired 226,000 shares of the Norwalk, Conn. construction management services company in transactions on April 14 and April 15.
The group said it bought the shares for investment purposes and has indicated to the company's management that it may purchase more shares.

The Los Angeles investor said it may opt in the future to to hold discussions with management, among other alternatives. Based on its evaluation of the company's business prospects, it may purchase more shares, according to the SEC filing.
